name: ProductsApi_RateLimit_Enforced_ByPolicy
description:
What: Validate API rate limiting per free-tier constraints (ApiPerMinute=20).
Steps:
1) Send >20 requests to /api/products within the same minute.
Expected: At least one response has status 429 Too Many Requests.
